architectural-decision-records.why: the change records an architectural decision (the gate-manifest contract)
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0041 defining gate-manifest.json as the single source of truth for skill-to-CI sync, with considered options and consequences
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the schema contract is proven, not asserted
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added a dependency-free test that validates the example against the schema and rejects a battery of malformed manifests and fails closed on unimplemented schema keywords, so the contract discriminates
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code (a .mjs test), so the test strategy is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: added a contract test for the schema (valid example plus ten malformed cases); a single contract-level suite is the right test-pyramid level for a JSON schema
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the coupling rule fires on the added .mjs; the behavior is covered by committed Gherkin
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the schema's behavior is enumerated as Gherkin in the merged bootstrap-v2 feature files (sync-drift, version-updates, malicious-actor reference the manifest); this change ships the contract they assume plus a contract test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR is explicit about what the contract does and does not guarantee
skeptical-audit.what: stated that until the parity gate exists the manifest is a documented contract, not a live guarantee, and named the risk
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: the change was reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch review over the ADR, schema, example, and the contract test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a data-contract/source-of-truth decision recorded as an ADR; no system, resilience, or scalability architecture built

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a declarative data format chosen and recorded in the ADR's considered options

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no code touching input, auth, sessions, data, files, or dependencies; a schema and docs

release-deployment-safety.why: nothing is deployed, migrated, or released

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration; the manifest is CI config metadata

arch-encode.why: no newly-caught mistake to encode as a rule in this change
